iterations.hypothesis: Replace pointwise BCE with a within-user listwise softmax. The metrics (GAUC, nDCG@5) rank inside a user's impression list, so a per-impression likelihood optimises the wrong quantity; a listwise objective is invariant to per-user score offsets exactly as the metrics are.
